messages:
Maya T. (People Ops): Thread to coordinate onsite for Priyanka Rao (SF office) Thu Nov 12. She
s flying in from Bangalore, lands SFO 07:10. Needs: panel availability, temporary access badge, international expense process, vegetarian lunch, quiet room option, and Google Meet fallback.
Ethan C. (Recruiter): She asked for a 11:00 start window if possible (jetlag). Prefers a single long lunch break between loops. No allergies; vegetarian.
Noah H. (Hiring Manager): I can do 11:003:30 PT. Prefer 60m design, 30m culture.
Lina R. (Office Admin): I can reserve Room C and a small Quiet Room. Need full name for badge and license plate if she wants parking. Will order vegetarian boxed lunch at 12:30.
Ethan C. (Recruiter): Sending candidate a quick question about plate and whether she like rideshare or taxi prepay. Also told her we reimburse international receipts; will forward expense form link.
Maya T. (People Ops): Reimbursement summary to send candidate: originals preferred but photos accepted. Submit to travel@redwood.example within 30 days. Include conversion note: "amount in INR, converted to USD using xe.com on date of expense". Airport transfer pre-approved up to $90.
calendar-bot: Calendar event created: "Onsite  Priyanka Rao" Thu Nov 12 11:0013:30 PT  https://calendar.google.com/event?id=zz123 (rooms: Room C + Quiet Room, Meet fallback: https://meet.google.com/xxx-yyy-zzz).
Lina R. (Office Admin): Badge ready under 'Priyanka Rao'. Parking slot available in visitor lot; hold for plate TBD. Vegetarian lunch ordered. Quiet Room set with lower desk and spare laptop charger.
Ethan C. (Recruiter): Candidate confirmed plate = "TBD" (checking). I'll update tonight. I shared the expense checklist and Meet fallback with Priyanka and CC travel@redwood.example.
Maya T. (People Ops): Day-of checklist: 1) Confirm plate and update parking, 2) Confirm arrival ETA, 3) Send itinerary + Meet link 24h prior, 4) Ensure Quiet Room equipment. Ping here for any last-minute changes.
Noah H. (Hiring Manager): I'll join 10 min early and have the design prompt ready.
Ethan C. (Recruiter): Thanks everyone  will post final itinerary once plate confirmed. :thumbsup:
